b.speaker: voice
b.text: Congratulations, Miss Moreno. The motel played beautifully. Harcourt was supporting cast. You carried the picture.

c.speaker: voice
c.text: The initials on that Polaroid belong to Arlo Vance. Tommy's stunt coordinator. These days he runs a salvage yard outside Yermo and keeps dogs around the perimeter.

d.speaker: voice
d.text: Arlo knows who ordered the fire gag changed. Ask him what they fed the cameras after Tommy died.

f.speaker: cass
f.text: Arlo taught Tommy how to fall from a roof. He used to say the trick was forgetting the ground was there.

q1.speaker: cass
q1.text: Dogs hear everything. I'll make sure they hear nothing.

z.speaker: narration
z.text: The gold star is still on the bathroom mirror. This time she leaves it there on purpose.

c2.speaker: cass
c2.text: Arlo. He still owes Tommy forty bucks and a carburetor.
